info.title: TempleOS
info.description: Temple Management System API for managing temples, devotees, sevas, donations and events.

post.description:
Create a donation.

Validates:

- Temple exists and is active
- Devotee exists when devotee_id is provided
- Devotee belongs to the selected temple
- Donation amount is positive

Donation status starts as PENDING.

schema.title: Response List Donations Api V1 Donations Get

post.description:
Create a seva booking.

Validates:

- Devotee exists
- Seva exists and is active
- Devotee belongs to the same temple as seva
- Slot belongs to the selected seva
- Slot date matches booking date
- Slot is available
- Requested quantity fits remaining capacity

Amount is calculated automatically from:

    seva.amount × quantity

schema.title: Response List Bookings Api V1 Bookings Get

get.description:
List audit logs.

Temple users can only see audit logs for their
own temple.

SUPER_ADMIN must provide temple_id.

schema.title: Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Audit Get

get.description:
Return the main TempleOS dashboard.

Includes:

- Donation statistics
- Booking statistics
- Devotee statistics
- Festival statistics
- Event statistics
- Recent donations
- Recent bookings

post.description:
Create a payment.

A payment must be linked to exactly one of:

- a donation
- a seva booking

The payment amount must exactly match
the linked donation or booking amount.

Payment status always starts as PENDING.

Only one active payment (PENDING or SUCCESS)
is allowed for a donation or booking at a time.

schema.title: Response List Payments Api V1 Payments Get

post.description:
Create an event for a temple.

SUPER_ADMIN can create events for any temple.
TEMPLE_ADMIN can create events only for their
own temple.

get.description:
List events with filtering, search,
pagination and temple isolation.

schema.title: Response List Events Api V1 Events Get
Response List Temples Api V1 Temples Get

post.description:
Create a festival for a temple.

SUPER_ADMIN can create festivals for any temple.
TEMPLE_ADMIN can create festivals only for their
own temple.

get.description:
List festivals with search, date filtering,
pagination and temple isolation.

schema.title: Response List Festivals Api V1 Festivals Get

post.description:
Generate a receipt for a completed payment.

A receipt must be linked to either:

- a completed donation
- a confirmed/completed seva booking

but not both.

The receipt amount is taken directly from
the linked record.

schema.title: Response List Receipts Api V1 Receipts Get

get.description:
List users.

SUPER_ADMIN:
    Returns users across all temples.

TEMPLE_ADMIN:
    Returns users belonging only to their temple.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

post.description:
Create a temple-level operational user.

SUPER_ADMIN:
    Can create users for any active temple.

TEMPLE_ADMIN:
    Can only create users for their own temple.

get.description:
Get a single user.

TEMPLE_ADMIN can only access users from their temple.
SUPER_ADMIN can access any user.

patch.description:
Activate or deactivate a user.

Users can only be managed within the current admin's
authorized temple scope.

schema.title: Response List Devotees Api V1 Devotees Get
Response List Sevas Api V1 Sevas Get
Response List Seva Slots Api V1 Sevas  Seva Id  Slots Get
